summary: Isabella Bank Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $30M through Piper Sandler as sales agent. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices (closing price $43.24 on June 11, 2026). Piper Sandler receives up to 3% commission. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including the Grand River acquisition. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; it registers share sales under Rule 415(a)(4) with no fixed price, premium, or event risk.
